_comment: Water channels are walls.segments on the free_pack Water_tiles sheet, so world.gd's `_build_water_shimmer` paints the shimmer overlay automatically (sheet-match) AND they block movement (segment_cells joins the sim blocked set).
_comment_freezable: Freezing the two x=3 channel cells opens a vertical shortcut through blocked water; sleep thaws them.

floor_layers._pick: cave-floor variation reusing the cave biome's verified floor-tile neighborhood.

entities._comment: `burnable: true` is the ONLY tag the fire field seam keys on
entities.observe: A slumped heap of waterlogged timber and old rope, tarred black and long dead. It chokes the little side-nook past the ladder. Dry enough on top to take a flame, if you had one.
entities.burn_toast: [Firefly] — Fire catches the tarred rope and runs greedily through the pile. In moments it is ash and the nook stands open, breathing cold sewer air.
entities.locked_toast: Sodden timber and tarred rope, jammed wall to wall. You could haul at it for an hour, or you could burn it, if you had the means to make fire.

entities.observe: Pale green moss crusts the old brick in patches, breathing a cold light that never quite reaches the water. Drakes farmed it once, they say, to see down here without lanterns.
entities.toast: Phosphor moss clings to the brick, glowing a sick, cold green. Cool to the touch, and it hisses faintly when your shadow crosses it.

entities.observe: A carved stone boundary marker, Drake glyphs worn shallow. It counts cisterns and sluice-gates in a hand two centuries dead. Someone scratched a newer mark beside it: a spider, hastily.
entities.toast: An old Drake drainage marker, its glyphs half-swallowed by grime. You can just make out a map of channels — and a fresh scratch, shaped like a spider, gouged over the third cistern.

entities.observe: A market crate, swollen and burst, washed down through a grate above. Whatever was in it fed something down here long ago.
entities.toast: A ruined crate, half-sunk in silt. Merchant stamps still show under the rot: lost cargo, swallowed by the sewers and picked clean.

entities.observe: Cable-thick silk, black-and-silver banded, stretched wall to wall. Not a house spider's work. Something with a shield on its back spun this, and recently.
entities.toast: Ropes of banded silk choke the side passage, strong as wire. Wrapped in it, drained pale: a rat, a boot, something that used to be a Watchman's lantern.

entities._comment: Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so C3's SKILL path can [Appraise Foe] the nest without triggering combat.
entities.observe: Two of them, banded carapaces catching the moss-light, waiting where the silk is thickest. Their legs test the air toward you. Behind them the tunnel drops away, and more eyes catch the light down there than you want to count.

entities._comment: reachable WITHOUT interacting the interact-only shield_spiders at (15,10), so scouting never trips the fight.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A perfect vantage over the nest, for a trained eye.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Foe] — You lie flat on the ledge and read the nest like a map. Two sentries on the silk, a brood-hollow behind them, and a tunnel dropping away toward the Dungeon proper. That's where the rest of them are. Count, size, exits: you have it all, and you never had to draw a blade.

entities.locked_toast: The ledge overlooks the nest: a perfect vantage, if you had the eye to read one. You don't, quite. Not yet.

entities._comment: The descent seam, gated on Act III's tremor beat.
entities.observe: The floor gave way here, not long ago: a raw crack breathing air colder and older than the sewers ever hold. The claw-scores on its lip all point one way: down. Something climbed up through this, and means to again.
entities.toast: A fresh fissure splits the sewer floor, exhaling a dry, breathing cold from far below. Deep gouges rake the stone lip. Something big has been using this as a door.

door_when.open_toast: You lower yourself into the fissure. The sewer's damp falls away behind you, and a dry, ancient cold rises to meet your hands. The dark below swallows the last of the light from above.

entities.observe: A single page, gone soft with damp, wedged where the old brick has cracked.

entities._comment: present_when makes Pell structurally absent—not cosmetically hidden—until missing_recruit_started is banked on the barracks map; prevents pre-quest discovery and render-count drift.

dialogue.speaker: Pell
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Just — turned around in the dark, that's all.

entities._comment: R6 (#95) trap placement 1/2: sewer_vermin nest approach snag.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: Nothing else glints in the nest today.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Wire, taut and low, strung off a rusted stanchion. Something in the nest rigged this. Careful hands could clear it.
entities.locked_toast: A length of wire runs low across the passage, pinned to a rusted stanchion. Whatever it's meant to catch, you can't tell how to spring it safe.

on_skill_use.toast: You ease the wire off its catch and coil it loose. A few scavenged links clatter free, worth a coin or two melted down.

entities._comment: R6 (#95) trap placement 2/2: shield_spiders/nest_ledge approach snag, south flank away from the y11 walkway cisterns_scout/cisterns_fight both walk edge to edge.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The drain has given up all it's going to give today.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Bone and wire, tangled at the drain mouth, rigged for something bigger than rats. A steady hand could clear it.
entities.locked_toast: Bone and wire, tangled at the drain mouth. It has the shape of a trap. You can't read it well enough to touch it — that's trap-craft, a rogue's trade.

on_skill_use.toast: You work the bone pins loose and unwind the wire. A few coins sit wedged in the silt beneath it, dropped by whoever it once caught.
